split: SHA256(seed|dataset|image_name), first 8 hex digits / 2**32: train < .6, dev < .8, else test
scope: with_gt trials with at least two scored candidates; all candidates require metadata and yes/no labels
quality: within-trial midrank percentile of published human BT scores; higher is better
risk: published yes over-processing/hallucination flag, not independently verified factual hallucination
decision: GO only if held-out risk reduction >= .01, paired source-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0, and quality-loss 95% upper bound <= .05 versus train-only predicted-quality selection
disclosure: Retrospective pilot. Aggregate oracle counts were explored before freezing this protocol. This is not an untouched external validation or a preregistration. No test-label tuning is permitted.
